title: Resumed reconnect-fallback deadline is not clamped against the wall clock stepping backwards
outcome: Resumed reconnect-fallback deadline is not clamped against the wall clock stepping backwards
acceptance: A resumed reconnect-fallback delay never exceeds RECONNECT_STATE_RESYNC_MAX_DELAY_MS even if the wall clock moves backwards between scheduling and recreation, covered by a test; the app-live-state.ts backoff comment names every reset trigger.
